# Integration Test Suite: Order Fulfillment System

```python
import pytest
from testcontainers.compose import DockerCompose
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, patch
import asyncio
from uuid import uuid4

# ============= FIXTURES =============

@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def services():
    """Spin up all microservices via docker-compose."""
    with DockerCompose(".", compose_file_name="docker-compose.test.yml") as compose:
        compose.wait_for("http://localhost:8001/health")  # Order
        compose.wait_for("http://localhost:8002/health")  # Inventory
        compose.wait_for("http://localhost:8003/health")  # Payment
        compose.wait_for("http://localhost:8004/health")  # Notification
        yield compose

@pytest.fixture
def order_id():
    return str(uuid4())

@pytest.fixture
def test_order(order_id):
    return {"order_id": order_id, "items": [{"sku": "TEST-001", "qty": 2}], "amount": 99.99}

@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
async def cleanup(order_id):
    """Isolate test data - cleanup after each test."""
    yield
    await cleanup_order_data(order_id)

# ============= HAPPY PATH =============

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_complete_order_flow(services, test_order):
    """Full order: inventory reserved -> payment -> notification sent."""
    response = await submit_order(test_order)
    
    assert response.status == "confirmed"
    assert await inventory_reserved(test_order["items"])
    assert await payment_captured(test_order["amount"])
    assert await notification_sent(test_order["order_id"], "ORDER_CONFIRMED")

# ============= SERVICE FAILURES =============

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_inventory_failure_no_payment(services, test_order):
    """Inventory fails -> no payment attempted."""
    with mock_service_failure("inventory"):
        response = await submit_order(test_order)
    
    assert response.status == "failed"
    assert not await payment_attempted(test_order["order_id"])

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_payment_failure_unreserves_inventory(services, test_order):
    """Payment fails -> inventory reservation rolled back."""
    with mock_service_failure("payment"):
        response = await submit_order(test_order)
    
    assert response.status == "failed"
    assert await inventory_unreserved(test_order["items"])

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_notification_failure_order_still_confirmed(services, test_order):
    """Notification failure doesn't fail the order."""
    with mock_service_failure("notification"):
        response = await submit_order(test_order)
    
    assert response.status == "confirmed"  # Order succeeds despite notification failure

# ============= TIMEOUT & RETRY =============

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_payment_timeout_triggers_retry(services, test_order):
    """Payment timeout -> 3 retries before failure."""
    with mock_service_timeout("payment", retries_before_success=2):
        response = await submit_order(test_order)
    
    assert response.status == "confirmed"
    assert await payment_attempts_count(test_order["order_id"]) == 3

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_exhausted_retries_triggers_compensation(services, test_order):
    """All retries exhausted -> compensating transaction."""
    with mock_service_timeout("payment", retries_before_success=99):
        response = await submit_order(test_order)
    
    assert response.status == "failed"
    assert await inventory_unreserved(test_order["items"])

# ============= ASYNC MESSAGE HANDLING =============

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_out_of_order_messages_handled(services, test_order):
    """System handles messages arriving out of sequence."""
    await publish_message("payment.success", test_order["order_id"])
    await publish_message("inventory.reserved", test_order["order_id"])  # Late
    
    await asyncio.sleep(1)  # Allow processing
    assert await order_state(test_order["order_id"]) == "confirmed"

# ============= COMPENSATING TRANSACTIONS =============

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_partial_refund_on_partial_fulfillment(services):
    """Multi-item order with partial stock -> partial refund."""
    order = {"items": [{"sku": "A", "qty": 1}, {"sku": "B", "qty": 1}], "amount": 50}
    with mock_partial_inventory(available=["A"]):
        response = await submit_order(order)
    
    assert await refund_issued(amount=25)  # Half refunded
```

**Key design decisions:**
- **Testcontainers** for realistic service simulation
- **UUID-based isolation** prevents test interference
- **Autouse cleanup fixture** ensures data isolation
- **Context managers** for failure injection keep tests readable
